verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence of an in-product AI is a single marketing line on the Fieldwork page: you describe a control and Fieldwork's AI agents collect, validate, and package the evidence. That is a narrow form of task delegation. The MCP server and service keys let external assistants act on the workspace, which is an adjacent capability, not a built-in assistant, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documentation of a general-purpose built-in assistant, a description of how tasks are delegated in the UI, the range of tasks beyond evidence collection, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Describe your control. Fieldwork’s AI agents collect, validate, and package the evidence – across your enterprise systems, on your schedule.
